plugins.description: Foresight from the signals, yearly counts and research a project already has: which signals to keep, whether a series moved against its own past, base rates, drivers, contrasting scenarios, forecasts with a date that are scored later, stress tests, signposts and reviews. One skill with thirteen playbooks and five scripts, and the foresight-analyst and forecaster agents.
